title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys
description: Join Ash accompanied by his partner Pikachu, as he travels through many regions, meets new friends and faces new challenges on his quest to become a Pokémon Master.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x1
episodes_data.description: Though he's excited to attend Professor Oak's Pokémon camp, Ash oversleeps when the day arrives. Newcomer Goh is just as excited — and on time.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x2
episodes_data.description: Professor Oak invites Ash to the opening ceremony for Professor Cerise's new lab in Vermilion City. Goh sets out to catch a legendary Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x3
episodes_data.description: Professor Cerise asks Ash and Goh to investigate the sudden appearance of Ivysaur in Vermilion City, but the two researchers disagree on their methods.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x4
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh head to the Galar region on assignment. During their stopover, some Pokémon steal Ash's backpack — with Ash and Goh's train tickets inside!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x5
episodes_data.description: Once they get off the train, Ash and Goh set out on the hunt for Dynamax Pokémon. Meanwhile, a Scorbunny is hot on their trail.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x6
episodes_data.description: After learning more about the Pokédex functions on their Rotom Phones from Professor Cerise, Ash and Goh head out to catch some local Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x7
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh travel to the Hoenn region, where Ash has entered Goh into the Battle Frontier Flute Cup. Their first opponents are Hodge and his Hariyama.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x8
episodes_data.description: The internet is full of reports that legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh has been seen in the Johto region. The researchers head to Ecruteak City to check it out.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x9
episodes_data.description: The internet is full of reports that legendary Pokémon Ho-Oh has been seen in the Johto region. The researchers head to Ecruteak City to check it out.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x10
episodes_data.description: After a ship's captain reports being saved by a Dragonite, Goh and Ash set out in search of the Dragonite island that they believe exists ... somewhere.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x11
episodes_data.description: While the laboratory staff deal with a mysterious power outage, Chloe contemplates her future and her relationship with Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x12
episodes_data.description: Professor Cerise gives Ash and Goh tickets to the World Coronation Series finals in the Galar region, where the strongest trainers battle for glory!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x13
episodes_data.description: When a Gigantamax Drednaw interrupts the World Coronation finals in pursuit of Team Rocket, Ash, Goh and their Pokémon spring into action!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x14
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh travel to the Unova region, where they head to the newly discovered Ruins of the Titan site at Desert Resort to search for Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x15
episodes_data.description: After snow in Vermilion City forces Professor Cerise to shut down the lab for system maintenance, Goh heads home for a few days to visit his family.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x16
episodes_data.description: Gengar's hauntings at the lab resume. Ash and Goh vow to capture the poltergeist Pokémon, and Professor Cerise explains the lab's paranormal history.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x17
episodes_data.description: After Darmanitan taunts Scorbunny in a practice battle, Scorbunny is determined to learn the Ember attack, but getting Goh's attention is a challenge.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x18
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh head to the Vermilion Gym, where Ash challenges the substitute Gym Leader as his first World Coronation Series opponent.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x19
episodes_data.description: Goh and Ash visit a film set, where the star, a Ditto, flees after a fight with the director. They search for her, but she's fallen in with Team Rocket!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x20
episodes_data.description: Pokémon Orienteering day dawns bright and early, with Ash, Goh and Professor Cerise each leading a group of kids on a trek through Vermilion City.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x21
episodes_data.description: After learning about Pokémon Eggs, Goh wants to find one. Ash's latest World Coronation Series match ends with him feeling like someone is calling him.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x22
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh head to the Hoenn region to witness the annual migration of Beautifly, but first they have to find them. Goh's Raboot starts acting out.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x23
episodes_data.description: Someone seems to be stealing the food that the researchers leave out for Pokémon in Cerise Park. To catch the culprit, Ash and Goh camp out.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x24
episodes_data.description: Team Rocket are sent to the Sinnoh region for a vacation, but their break is interrupted by the arrival of Ash and Goh looking for a special Pokémon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x25
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh head to the Kalos region, where Goh wants to catch Kalos Pokémon and Ash sets his sights on a World Coronation Series Battle Festival.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x26
episodes_data.description: Goh enters his giant Magikarp in the tenth annual Magikarp High Jump Tournament. Then he and Ash head to Slowpoke Island, hoping to catch a Slowpoke.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x27
episodes_data.description: Professor Cerise gives Ash and Goh tickets to a World Coronation Series Master Class battle in Galar, with challenger Raihan battling champion Leon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x28
episodes_data.description: A Sobble sneaks up on Ash and Goh while they're eating at the Wyndon Pokémon Center. To catch it, they have to follow a trail of crying people.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x29
episodes_data.description: Yamper brings home an injured Pidove, so Professor Cerise and his family decide to nurse it back to health. Chloe has her hands full keeping the peace!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x30
episodes_data.description: Ash and Riolu are on a roll after the latest World Coronation Series battle, and Pikachu is jealous! When Ash's mom visits, Pikachu follows her home.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x31
episodes_data.description: Chloe asks Ash and Goh to step in at her younger brother Parker's school: His friend Nami is upset that other kids say her Feebas isn't cute.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x32
episodes_data.description: Goh joins his parents for a family vacation in the Johto region. Walking through the woods, he recalls meeting another trainer there three years ago.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x33
episodes_data.description: The local Pokémon Center is hosting a Pokémon trading event. When Ash and Goh head over to check it out, they meet a trainer who's a Bug-type enthusiast.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x34
episodes_data.description: Ash travels to Saffron City to battle his next opponent, but when he learns that the Karate Master has been defeated, he challenges the victor instead.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x35
episodes_data.description: Goh decides to catch a Pikachu, and Professor Cerise informs him about a mass outbreak of Pikachu in the mountains. But Team Rocket is on the hunt too!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x36
episodes_data.description: After Ash battles new opponents in the World Coronation Series, the Cerise Laboratory researchers head to the Hoenn region to investigate a sandstorm.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x37
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh head to the Alola region and reunite with Professor Kukui, Professor Burnet and Ash's human and Pokémon friends at the Pokémon School.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x38
episodes_data.description: With Chloe in tow, Ash and Goh visit the Pewter Museum of Science. Goh heads to a public dig site to find a Fossil Pokémon, but Team Rocket is there!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x39
episodes_data.description: Goh and Ash travel to the Cianwood Gym in the Johto region so Ash can take on Bea in a World Coronation Series rematch.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x40
episodes_data.description: When a hot day in Vermilion City turns thunderous, Ash, Goh and Professor Cerise suspect that the Legendary bird Pokémon Zapdos is somewhere nearby.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x41
episodes_data.description: While Meowth battles a cold, Jessie and James review a video of Ash's Pikachu. On a forest walk, Ash and Goh try to help a wild Marshtomp.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x42
episodes_data.description: Ash and Goh set out for the Galar region to investigate the Dynamax phenomenon. During a train delay, they meet strange Pokémon in a mysterious forest.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x43
episodes_data.description: While Goh and Sonia investigate the Darkest Day in Turffield, Team Rocket infiltrates the Galar Energy Plant, with Ash and Leon heading there too.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x44
episodes_data.description: Ash heads to Stow-on-Side to meet Sonia and Goh, who conclude that the Darkest Day is a Pokémon. At the Energy Plant, Leon encounters it directly.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x45
episodes_data.description: At the stadium, Leon and Team Rocket are no match for Eternatus. Ash takes on Chairman Rose while Goh battles Oleana to break through and end the chaos.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x46
episodes_data.description: When Psychic energy is detected on Cero Island, Ash and Goh head out in hopes of finding Mew. When they get there, they meet an old foe: Mewtwo!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x47
episodes_data.description: The Vermilion City Pokémon Eating Contest is on, and Ash, Goh and their Pokémon are competing for a trip to Unova. Team Rocket wants to win too.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 23 Journeys 23x48
episodes_data.description: Setting out on Goh's prize trip, Ash and Goh arrive in Castelia City. Unbeknownst to them, Team Rocket is lying in wait to kidnap Pikachu!
